newsletter.looks: A sign-up band: a background photo, a heading, a short line and either a newsletter picker (a dropdown that opens the chosen newsletter's sign-up page) or an email field with a button.
newsletter.use: Near the end of a page, when the author asks for a sign-up.

fields.form_type: dropdown (default): a list of newsletters, each opening its own sign-up page (form_options, one Label|URL per line). input: an email field that subscribes directly.
fields.form_options: For dropdown only: one newsletter per line as Label|URL.
